rubric.description: Declares a constructor named Rectangle with two double parameters
Correctly assigns the width parameter to the width field (e.g. this.width = width)
Correctly assigns the height parameter to the height field
Declares getBalance as a public method returning double, and correctly returns balance
Declares deposit as a public void method taking a double parameter
Checks that amount is positive (e.g. if (amount > 0)) before modifying the balance
Correctly adds amount to balance when the check passes
Declares the method with the static keyword and correct signature
Correctly computes the average of a and b (e.g. (a + b) / 2)
